title: Testrix CLI config
description: Config file for testrix-cli. See https://github.com/kamauvick/Testrix#config-file-optional. Every key is optional except projectId/apiKey, which can also come from TESTRIX_PROJECT_ID/TESTRIX_API_KEY.

serverApiUrl.description: Defaults to the prod dashboard API.

dashboardUrl.description: Web UI base for the printed run link; derived from serverApiUrl otherwise.

reportsDir.description: Auto-discovered when omitted (test-results/, test-reports/, reports/, junit/, .).

reportFiles.description: Explicit files, directories, or globs, in addition to reportsDir.

userId.description: Defaults to the CI actor, then git config user.email, then the OS user.

name.description: Test run name; defaults to the CI workflow/job name, then the discovered suite names.

startTime.description: Defaults to the run window read from the reports.
